description: This file defines an event subscriber class for the OrangeHRM system that hooks into Symfony's kernel events to intercept controller actions and enforce access restrictions during functional testing modes. It is part of the testing plugin logic, checking request paths and configuration mode to potentially throw exceptions.
published: OrangeHRM unctionalTesting	est unctional	ools	ools unctions.php

classes.name: FunctionalTestingPluginSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that listens for KernelController events to restrict access during functional testing, based on request path and system configuration.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the Symfony KernelEvents::CONTROLLER event.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Event handler that checks if the request is for a functional testing path and enforces restrictions by throwing ForbiddenException if conditions match.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the controller object from the event.
